events.body: This is a driver-filed safety dispute. The chat is short and fully timestamped: the driver asked the rider not to smoke in the car at 18:24 [F3], and the rider replied at 18:24 "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4], on a record where every message carries a timestamp [F5]. A punch threat aimed at the other party is not a route argument or mere rudeness; it is a threat of physical violence directed at the driver, and Ryde's code of conduct bars "Assault, harassment, or abuse of any kind ... including Threats and Intimidation" [SAFE-1]. The driver's post-trip statement corroborates the same account and adds that he kept driving and did not answer [F6]. Where a threat appears in the chat or a complaint, no automatic ruling is issued and the case goes to a person with a factual summary [SAFE-1]; the trace confirms this branch is the only allowed outcome.
